# `vfx-effect` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "vfx-effect" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/vfx-effect/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | required | Effect id: the VFX cue id moves and spells name (style bible §15.1), e.g. "vfx-impact-sparks". |
| `notes` | string | required | What the effect shows and where it is used, for review. |
| `priority` | integer 0–100 | `50` | 0–100: when the particle budget is full, lower-priority effects are culled first. |
| `duration` | number > 0 | required | Seconds the effect emits for; a looping effect repeats its bursts each period. |
| `loop` | boolean | `false` | Emit until stopped instead of once. |
| `socket` | id | — | Default socket when spawned on an entity (e.g. "hand-r"); default: its origin. |
| `lowRateScale` | number 0–1 | `0.5` | Emission multiplier on the Low tier (rate and burst counts). |
| `emitters` | list of object (at least 1) | required | The particle emitters. |
| `emitters[].id` | id | required | Emitter id, unique within the effect, e.g. "core". |
| `emitters[].texture` | string | required | Texture or flipbook asset id; placeholders are generated until the asset lands. |
| `emitters[].flipbook` | object | — | The texture is a grid of animation frames. |
| `emitters[].flipbook.cols` | integer 1–16 | required | Frame columns in the sheet (style bible: 4 or 8). |
| `emitters[].flipbook.rows` | integer 1–16 | required | Frame rows in the sheet. |
| `emitters[].flipbook.fps` | number > 0 | — | Frames per second, looping; default: play the sheet once over the particle’s life. |
| `emitters[].blend` | `"additive"` \| `"alpha"` | required | additive for glowing magic cores, alpha for smoke, dust and debris. |
| `emitters[].rate` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Particles per second while the effect emits. |
| `emitters[].bursts` | list of object | `[]` | One-off emissions at fixed times. |
| `emitters[].bursts[].at` | number ≥ 0 | required | Seconds after the effect starts. |
| `emitters[].bursts[].count` | integer > 0 | required | Particles emitted at once. |
| `emitters[].lifetime` | object | required | Particle lifetime range, seconds. |
| `emitters[].lifetime.min` | number > 0 | required | Smallest particle lifetime, seconds (> 0). |
| `emitters[].lifetime.max` | number > 0 | — | Largest particle lifetime, seconds (> 0); default: min. |
| `emitters[].speed` | object | — | Launch speed range, m/s. |
| `emitters[].speed.min` | number ≥ 0 | required | Smallest launch speed, m/s. |
| `emitters[].speed.max` | number ≥ 0 | — | Largest launch speed, m/s; default: min. |
| `emitters[].coneDeg` | number 0–180 | `0` | Half-angle of the launch cone around the effect’s up axis; 180 = any direction. |
| `emitters[].spawnRadius` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Particles start anywhere within this many metres of the effect’s origin. |
| `emitters[].gravity` | number | `0` | Downward acceleration, m/s² (negative rises, like smoke). |
| `emitters[].drag` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Velocity lost per second, as a fraction. |
| `emitters[].size` | number ≥ 0 or list of object (at least 1) | `0.2` | Particle size in metres over its life. |
| `emitters[].size[].t` | number 0–1 | required | Point in the particle’s life, 0 = born, 1 = dies. |
| `emitters[].size[].v` | number ≥ 0 | required | Value at t. |
| `emitters[].color` | string or list of object (at least 1) | required | Particle colour over its life (`#FFFFFF` only in emissive cores). |
| `emitters[].color[].t` | number 0–1 | required | Point in the particle’s life, 0 = born, 1 = dies. |
| `emitters[].color[].color` | string | required | Colour at t. |
| `emitters[].alpha` | number 0–1 or list of object (at least 1) | `[{"t":0,"v":1},{"t":1,"v":0}]` | Opacity over the particle’s life (default fades out). |
| `emitters[].alpha[].t` | number 0–1 | required | Point in the particle’s life, 0 = born, 1 = dies. |
| `emitters[].alpha[].v` | number 0–1 | required | Value at t. |
| `emitters[].minTier` | `"low"` \| `"high"` | `"low"` | Lowest quality tier the emitter runs on; "high" drops it on Low. |
